Message:
net: dsa: mv88e6xxx: factorize GLOBAL_CONTROL_2 setup

All switch models setup the GLOBAL_CONTROL_2 register with slightly
differences.

Since the cascade mode is valid even in a single chip setup, factorize
such configuration.
